name: o-control
description: Desktop companion for Onkyo CR-N775 receiver control via eISCP

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/eiscp/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/upnp/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/service/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tools/mock-receiver/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/raycast/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:app: npm run build:sidecar && npm run tauri:build -w @o-control/desktop
